worldcombat.skill.fairylock.summary: Raise a symmetric boundary: caster, allies and foes can move inside, with restraint only near the edge. External departure or native refusal releases a member; newcomers can enter.
worldcombat.skill.fairylock.use.0: Lock a fleeing foe inside one patch of ground while your team focuses it
worldcombat.skill.fairylock.use.1: Pin a whole melee in place in tight terrain
worldcombat.skill.fairylock.use.2: Trap a highly mobile target in a small patch it cannot break away from
The fixed boundary has radius %1$s blocks and lasts %2$s. Movement stays normal inside; restraint acts near its edge.
Later entrants join. Actors moved outside or refusing native received movement are released. Expiry or source departure removes the boundary and its owned statuses.
worldcombat.skill.fairylock.option.on: Deep lock: the seal lasts x1.4; the cost is radius x0.8, wind-up +4 ticks and cooldown +20 ticks — held longer but a smaller, slower, pricier cage.
worldcombat.skill.fairylock.option.off: Wide lock: a larger ring, faster and cheaper; the cost is a shorter hold.
worldcombat.skill.fairylock.timing: Seal radius %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP and cooldown %5$s from commit. The wind-up can be interrupted at no cost.
worldcombat.skill.fairylock.growth.0: From level %1$s: the seal radius rises to %2$s blocks and the cooldown drops to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.fairylock.preference.d: On (Deep lock): the seal lasts x1.4, at the cost of radius x0.8, wind-up +4 ticks and cooldown +20 ticks — held longer but a smaller, slower cage. Off (Wide lock): a bigger ring, faster and cheaper, but a shorter hold.
worldcombat.skill.fairylock.preference.a: The partner only considers the seal while a threat is this close; larger drops it earlier and risks trapping itself in the far field.
The partner drops the seal once this many hostile bodies are inside the radius; 1 seals on a single foe, larger waits for a cluster worth an even-handed cage.
On: a fleeing target adds a rank — a ring shuts the exit. Off: rank only by how many bodies the seal would catch.
On: the partner leaves its post under a stay order to drop the seal. Off: it only casts when already in range.
